system_description.narrative_title: Fed hold, bond-market revolt, and Asia market spillovers
system_description.narrative_summary: Across this window markets priced a growing disconnect between the Federal Reserve’s decision to hold rates and signals from the bond market that higher policy is needed. Rising Treasury yields and a surge in front- and long-end rates pressured equities (notably Korean tech), weakened the dollar/strengthened the yen, and provoked currency intervention talk — putting the Fed’s credibility and global capital flows at the center of the shock. The interaction between central-bank communication, market expectations, and cross-border capital movements created reinforcing feedbacks and rapid spillovers into Asian markets and FX.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary: US monetary policy decisions and communication (Fed/Chair Warsh), the bond market (yields, curve), investor positioning and sentiment, equity-market reactions (US and Asian, especially Korea and Japan), foreign-exchange moves and interventions (yen), and immediate macro data/commodity signals that inform policy expectations (inflation, energy).
system_description.super_system: Global macro-financial system (cross-border capital flows, central banks, sovereigns, and international trade/real economy)
adjacent_subsystems: Foreign-exchange markets and official currency intervention mechanisms
Asian equity markets and semiconductor/supply-chain sector dynamics
Inflation and real economy indicators (energy costs, growth outlook)

variables.name: Central bank communication clarity
variables.description: Degree of clarity and coherence in official monetary-policy messages and guidance as perceived by market participants.

variables.name: Monetary policy stance
variables.description: Current stance of monetary policy measured as the degree of monetary tightening or easing relative to neutral.

variables.name: Market-implied policy path
variables.description: Market-implied trajectory of future policy rates and timing derived from interest-rate instruments and derivatives.

variables.name: Bond yield levels
variables.description: Absolute levels of sovereign and benchmark bond yields across maturities.

variables.name: Yield curve slope
variables.description: Spread between longer-term and shorter-term bond yields indicating term-structure steepness.

variables.name: Bond market risk premium
variables.description: Incremental yield component investors demand over expected policy rates to hold bonds, reflecting risk and term premia.

variables.name: Investor sentiment
variables.description: Aggregate market participants' risk appetite and confidence levels across asset classes.

variables.name: Equity valuation levels
variables.description: Price and valuation metrics of equity markets, capturing aggregate equity price levels relative to fundamentals.

variables.name: Equity market volatility
variables.description: Observed and implied short- and medium-term volatility of equity prices.

variables.name: Foreign exchange rates
variables.description: Nominal cross-currency exchange rate levels and relative currency strengths.

variables.name: FX intervention probability
variables.description: Perceived likelihood and market expectation of official currency intervention actions.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: Net cross-border flows of capital into and out of markets and asset classes over time.

variables.name: Market liquidity
variables.description: Depth and ease of trading in financial markets, measured by bid-ask spreads, market depth, and transaction costs.

variables.name: Inflationary pressure
variables.description: Underlying pressure on price levels from demand, wages, and supply-side constraints as reflected in core inflation trends.

variables.name: Commodity price levels
variables.description: Prices of key commodities (energy, metals, agricultural) that influence input costs and inflation expectations.

variables.name: Leverage and concentration
variables.description: Aggregate degree of market leverage and concentration in specific assets or strategies that amplify systemic risk.

catalysts.title: Fed follow-up communications and speeches
catalysts.description: Additional public remarks, pressers, and clarified guidance from Fed officials that could resolve or deepen market confusion about policy.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Kevin Warsh is confusing markets'; 'Warsh’s stripped-back Fed communication already backfiring'; 'What to Watch for at the Fed Meeting'.

catalysts.title: Bond-market repricing that pressures Fed to act
catalysts.description: Sustained rise in sovereign yields and front-end rates that force markets to price a tighter Fed path or prompt Fed tightening decisions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'The Bond Market Is Forcing the Fed’s Hand'; 'Bond market is calling Warsh’s bluff'; '2-Year Treasury Yield Nears Key Breakout'.

catalysts.title: Possible US/Japan (and rare joint) yen intervention
catalysts.description: Heightened odds of official FX intervention in the yen following sharp moves and US Treasury warnings to banks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'US Treasury informed banks that it may intervene in yen'; 'Japan’s yen jumps... speculation over intervention'; 'Rare joint currency intervention sends strong message'.

catalysts.title: BOJ policy signals and government actions to prop yen
catalysts.description: BOJ hawkish signals combined with government measures to support the yen could alter regional rates and FX dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'BOJ holds rates at 1%, warns of core inflation exceeding 2%'; 'BOJ keeps rates steady, delivers hawkish signal as government props up yen'.

catalysts.title: Japan quake halting auto and chip plants
catalysts.description: Damage and plant stoppages in Japan that disrupt auto and semiconductor supply chains, with knock-on commodity and inflation effects.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Japan quake halts auto and chip plants'; 'Japan quake snarls auto and chip supply chains'.

catalysts.title: South Korea caps on single-stock leveraged ETFs
catalysts.description: Regulatory caps and interventions targeting leveraged single-stock ETFs that aim to curb extreme swings and speculation.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'South Korea to cap investment in single-stock leveraged ETFs'; 'Top South Korean policy makers apologise...'.

catalysts.title: Sustained high Treasury and mortgage rates
catalysts.description: Persistent elevation in Treasury yields and mortgage rates that feed through to borrowing costs and investor allocations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Mortgage rates jump to their highest level in a year'; 'US borrowing costs hit 19-year high; U.S. Treasury Yields Rise'.

catalysts.title: Commodity/inflation upside from Middle East conflict
catalysts.description: Escalation or persistence of Middle East hostilities that could reverse recent inflation deceleration via energy and commodity shocks.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US inflation slows in June, but reversal likely amid Middle East conflict'.
